QuestInfo.name: A Lesson on Job Advancement
QuestInfo.0: What do you have to do to start the job you like? Better talk to Olaf in Lith Harbor to find out.
QuestInfo.1: Listen carefully as #p1002101# describes the details of each job. There'll be a quiz afterwards!
QuestInfo.2: You solved all of #p1002101#'s job quizzes. You can now select your job: #kWarrior, Magician, Bowman, Thief, or Pirate#k. Head to Perion to become a Warrior, Ellinia to become a Magician, Henesys to become a Bowman, Kerning City to become a Thief, or the Nautilus to become a Pirate.

0.1: Perhaps that was a little TOO short. Fine. Talk to #p1022000# in Perion to become a Warrior, to #p1012100# in Henesys to become a Bowman, to the #p1052001# in Kerning City to become a Thief, to #p1032001# in Ellinia to become a Magician, and to Kyrin in the Nautilus to become a Pirate.
0.2: Clear enough for you? I hope you paid attention. That info is important. Talk to me again when you're ready to answer my questions.
0.0: I'm not one for long talks, unless I'm discussing proper walrus wrestling form, so I'll keep this short. If you want to be somebody, you have to pick a job. You can do that at #blevel 10#k. Your choices are #bWarrior, Magician, Bowman, Thief, and Pirate#k.

yes.0: You've passed my test. Now it's time for you to decide which job (Warrior, Thief, Magician, Bowman, or Pirate) you want. Talk to me once you've made up your mind.

0.0: I already addressed this. You can become a Magician at Level 8. But I didn't ask about Magicians, did I?
0.1: Whoa, ambitious much? That's way too early to get your first job. Let me spoon-feed you: the answer is 10.

1.0: Perion's where the real muscle's at! It's a town of Warriors, like me.
1.2: If you're looking for somewhere to skulk around, bein' sneaky, go to Kerning City. There's a Thief named the Dark Lord there that'll teach you everything you know about... theify stuff.
1.3: With all the big trees to climb in Ellinia, you'd think there would be more tawny musclemen like myself swinging around... Mostly, you'll just find those smartypants Magicians.

1.0:
